articles.summary: -Q3 2026 total revenue of $23.1 million, including $22.9 million in RNS revenue representing 1% growth- -Revises full year 2026 revenue guidance to $91 million to $92 million; focused on improving commercial execution and accelerating growth- -Advances innovation pipeline with NeuroPace Remote Care ™ FDA submission and upcoming IGE PMA-S Amendment, supporting significant long-term growth opportunities- NeuroPace, Inc. (Nasdaq: NPCE), a medical device company focused on transforming the lives of people living with epilepsy, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and provided a corporate update. Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights Total revenue of $23.1 million in the third quarter of 2026 RNS System revenue of $22.9 million in the quarter, representing 1.4% growth compared to the third quarter of 2025 Net loss in the third quarter of 2026 was ($3.3) million compared to ($4.9) million in the third quarter of 2025 Adjusted EBITDA of $0.4
articles.title: NeuroPace Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Revised Full Year Guidance
